name: video-encoder
description: A local macOS video encoding workflow app.
author: Itsy Dev

scripts.pack: npm run check:runtime && node server/scripts/prepare-production-current.js && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.prod.js
scripts.dist: npm run check:runtime && node server/scripts/prepare-production-current.js && electron-builder --config electron-builder.prod.js
scripts.pack:win: npm run check:runtime && node server/scripts/prepare-production-current.js && electron-builder --dir --win --x64 --config electron-builder.prod.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run check:runtime && node server/scripts/prepare-production-current.js && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.prod.js
scripts.pack:dev: npm run check:runtime && node server/scripts/clean-build-output.js dev && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.dev.js
scripts.dist:dev: npm run check:runtime && node server/scripts/clean-build-output.js dev && electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.js
scripts.pack:dev:win: npm run check:runtime && node server/scripts/clean-build-output.js dev && electron-builder --dir --win --x64 --config electron-builder.dev.js
scripts.dist:dev:win: npm run check:runtime && node server/scripts/clean-build-output.js dev && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.dev.js
